reports.title: Epic Bharat
reports.description:
Welcome to the official home of the EPIC BHARAT SAGA.

We are creating the world's first Cinematic Documentary Series on the Mahabharata, Ramayana, and Ancient Indian History.

Our mission is to bring the greatest epics of Bharat to a global audience in 4K resolution, combining historical depth with modern cinematic storytelling.

🔥 THE SAGA BEGINS:
Season 1: The Mahabharata (18 Parvas in 18 Episodes)
Season 2: The Ramayana (Coming Soon)
Season 3: The Puranas & Vedic Wisdom (Coming Soon)
📱 Daily Shorts: Dashavatar series, roz 6:30 PM IST

🎬 WHAT TO EXPECT:
* High-Quality Cinematic Visuals
* In-depth Character Analysis (Karna, Krishna, Arjuna)
* Unbiased Retellings of Ancient Scripts
* The Philosophy of Dharma & Karma

Whether you are rediscovering your roots or hearing these stories for the first time, join us on this journey into the past.

For Business Inquiries & Sponsorships:
📧 epicbharat.official@gmail.com

SUBSCRIBE to witness the history of India like never before.
